poor.quote: what weighs is that every time it demands attention, that I am no longer master of it
I cannot get out of a man's way.
While on mine, everywhere and always, I meet a human being.
you who through the windows of houses, thousands of black mouths, forever breathe out your stench
In fact you become the slave

good.quote: like a wave at the shore
like air through windows and doors, like the waters of tributaries into a river
I confess I envy the planets: they have their orbits, and nothing stands in their path.
You flog the holy silence of the earth with the grinding of factories and the thunder of wheels
You toss into my heart, as into your own storeroom
You do not only walk beside me, you crawl inside me.
